description: Create an Ed25519 keypair. With a domain: returns the DNS TXT record to publish (SendForAI has no API keys; publishing this record is signing up). Without a domain: returns a sandbox identity that needs no DNS and can use the whole API against @simulator.sendforai.com right away; add a real domain to it later with add_domain or setup_dns. Store the private key in SENDFORAI_PRIVATE_KEY.

domain.description: A domain you control and will send from, e.g. example.com. Omit for a no-DNS sandbox identity.

name: generate_identity
title: Generate an identity
